questions.q: In a class, ratio of boys to the girls is 5:3. If 20% of the boys and 40% of the girls fail an exam, what is the ratio of the number of boys who passed to the number of girls who passed? (CHSL TIER I - 21/11/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, aise karna hai... Boys aur Girls ka ratio 5:3 hai. Total 500 aur 300 maan le. Fail hue 20% aur 40%. Toh pass hue 80% (500 ka 80% = 400) aur 60% (300 ka 60% = 180). Ratio = 400:180 = 20:9.

Best Approach: Direct fraction use kar. Passed ratio = (5 * 0.8) : (3 * 0.6) = 4 : 1.8 = 40:18 = 20:9. Ekdum verbal question tha, pen uthane ki jarurat nahi!

Summary: Hamesha values ko 100 ke multiple mein assume kar calculation easy karne ke liye CGL me.

questions.q: A farmer uses 2/3 of his land for wheat and 0.125 for rice. What fraction remains unused? (CPO TIER I- 09/12/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Wheat = 2/3, Rice = 0.125 yani 1/8. Total land ko 3 aur 8 ka LCM yani 24 maan le. Wheat = 16 unit, Rice = 3 unit. Total use hua 19. Bacha kitna? 24 - 19 = 5. Fraction = 5/24.

Best Method: LCM method se fractions avoid kar.

Summary: Jab bhi fractions aayein, denominator ka LCM total value maan liya kar, decimals se bach jayega.

questions.q: Gita purchases an apartment and pays EMI for that. Her monthly income is 1,20,000. She spends 20% on the education of her children, 35% on household affairs, sends 12% to GPF, saves 18% in a savings bank account and pays the rest of the amount as EMI. How much EMI does she pay?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, sabse pehle total percentage add kar. 20 + 35 + 12 + 18 = 85%. Bacha 15% jo EMI hai. 120000 ka 15% nikalna hai. 10% hua 12000, 5% hua 6000, total 18000.

Best Approach: Digital Sum (DS) laga. 120000 ka DS = 3. 15% ka DS = 6. 3 * 6 = 18 -> DS = 9. Options check kar, sirf 18000 ka DS 9 hai.

Summary: Percentages ko club kar aur agar numbers asaan hain toh mentally calculate kar, warna DS is your best friend.

questions.q: Doll's Math's test consists of 115 questions from three sections- i.e. A, B and C. 15 questions from section A, 40 questions from section B and 60 questions from section C. Although, she answered 66.67% of section A, 60% of section B and 50% of section C correctly. She did not pass the test because she got less than 60% of the total marks. How many more questions would she have to answer correctly to earn 60% of the marks, if each question's mark is 1?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, aise karna hai... A mein 2/3 * 15 = 10 sahi. B mein 60% of 40 = 24 sahi. C mein 50% of 60 = 30 sahi. Total marks aaye 64. Pass hone ke liye 115 ka 60% chahiye. 115 * 3/5 = 69 marks. Kitne aur chahiye? 69 - 64 = 5.

Best Approach: Direct individual values nikalna zyada fast hai kyunki numbers round figure mein hain.

Summary: Percentages ka fractional value yaad rakhna CGL mein game changer hota hai.

questions.q: Salary of A increased by 8% in the year 2015 as compared to 2014 and decreased by 6% in the year 2016 as compared to 2015. If his salary was Rs. 2,34,778 in 2016, his salary (round off to nearest whole number) in 2014 was:
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, isme mazdoori bilkul nahi karni! Net effect nikal: +8% aur -6% ka successive = 8 - 6 - (48/100) = +1.52% increment. Yani 101.52% = 234778. Approx 1.5% badhne ke baad value 234.7k hui hai, toh original pakka isse thoda kam hogi. Options dekh: 238k aur 236k bada hai, 234.9k almost same hai. Bacha sirf 231263.

Best Approach: Approximation aur option elimination is the key yaha par.

Summary: SSC options set karta hai smartly. Hamesha calculation se pehle options pe nazar maar, adha time yahi bach jayega.

questions.q: If 12.5% of p is equal to 50% of q, what is the ratio p: q? (CGL TIER I - 19/09/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... 12.5% hota hai 1/8 aur 50% hota hai 1/2. Question bol raha hai p/8 = q/2. Toh p/q = 8/2 = 4/1.

Best Approach: Fraction conversion se seconds mein answer aayega.

Summary: Standard percentages ke fractions tips par hone chahiye.

questions.q: The price of an item increases successively by 20% and 12% and then the resulting price is decreased by 30%. If the final price is 735 then 20% of the original price is?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, successive ka best tarika fractions hai. Initial aur Final ka ratio nikal. 20% = 1/5 (5 se 6), 12% = 3/25 (25 se 28), 30% = 3/10 (10 se 7). Total Initial = 5*25*10 = 1250. Total Final = 6*28*7 = 1176. Question mein 1176 unit ki value 735 di hai. 1 unit = 735/1176 = 5/8. Hamein original ka 20% (yani 1/5) chahiye. So, 1250 * (1/5) * (5/8) = 1250 / 8 = 156.25.

Best Approach: Ratio method for successive changes hamesha best hota hai calculation asaan karne ke liye.

Summary: Jab bhi continuous changes ho, fraction values ka vertically multiply karke sidha initial-final ratio bana liya kar.

questions.q: In an examination, A got 25% marks more than B, B got 10% less than C and C got 25% more than D. If D got 320 marks out of 500, the marks obtained by A were?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, peeche se shuru kar. D ka score 320 hai. C ko 25% (yani 1/4th) zyada mila, toh 320 + 80 = 400. B ko 10% kam mila, toh 400 - 40 = 360. A ko 25% (1/4th) zyada mila, toh 360 + 90 = 450.

Best Approach: Backwards chain process bina pen uthaye mentally solve ho sakti hai.

Summary: Percentage chain questions mein hamesha base value waha se pakdo jaha exact number diya ho.

questions.q: If 20% of X is added to 75% of X then the results become (X-21)% of 200 then find the value of 250% of X?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, pehle equation bana. 20%X + 75%X = 95%X. Aur right side mein 200 ka (X-21)% nikalna hai, yani sidha 2 se multiply kar de: 2X - 42. Toh 0.95X = 2X - 42. Difference aaya 1.05X = 42. X = 40. Hamein nikalna hai 250% (yani 2.5 times) of 40 = 100.

Best Method: Percentage ko decimals mein convert karke basic algebra laga, bohot fast hoga.

Summary: Jab bhi dono side variables ho, zero eliminate karke choti equation banao.

questions.q: Price of ticket in a circus increases by 33.33%, number of visitors reduces by 12.5%. Find effect on income?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Succesive case hai. Ticket price 1/3 se badha (3 se 4 hua). Visitors 1/8 se kam hue (8 se 7 hue). Multiply kar de: Initial Income = 3 * 8 = 24. Final Income = 4 * 7 = 28. Farak aya +4 ka 24 par. 4/24 = 1/6, jo ki direct 16.66% hota hai.

Best Approach: Ratio method is killer here.

Summary: Price * Consumption = Expenditure wale sabhi questions mein ye ratio multiply wala trick universally lagta hai.

questions.q: In 2003, the total population of a village was 3650, out of which 42% were females. In 2004, the total population increased by 10% as compared to the previous year. If the number of females remained the same in 2004, what was the percentage increase in the number of males in 2004 as compared to 2003 ?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, logic laga. Total population 10% badhi yani 365 badhi. Females same rahi, iska matlab jo 365 badhe hain wo sab males hain! 2003 mein males kitne the? 58% of 3650 = 2117. Toh 365 / 2117 nikalna hai. 2117 ka 10% hua 211.7, 5% hua 105.8. Approx 17.2% ke paas aayega.

Best Approach: Approximation lagao instead of pura division karne ke.

Summary: Hamesha identify kar ki actual absolute change kisme aa raha hai, falto ka calculation mat kar.

questions.q: The price of a commodity increased by 22%. By what percentage (correct to two decimal places) should its consumption be reduced so that the total expenditure remains the same?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Price 100 se 122 hua. Expenditure same rakhna hai toh consumption 122 se 100 karna padega. Kitna kam kiya? 22 kispe? 122 pe. Percentage = (22/122)*100 = 1100/61. Ab options dekho, 61 * 20 = 1220 hota hai, hamara numerator 1100 hai yani answer 20% se chota aayega. 61 * 18 approx 1098 hota hai. Sidha 18.03% tick kar.

Best Method: Approximation and option elimination.

Summary: Inverse proportion ke concepts mein direct reverse ratio use karke base identify kiya karo.

questions.q: Evaluate: 12.5% of 560 km + 66.66% of 240 km (CGL TIER I- 12/09/2025 - SHIFT 3)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, direct standard fractions hain. 12.5% hota hai 1/8, aur 66.66% hota hai 2/3. 560 ka 1/8 hua 70. 240 ka 2/3 hua 160. Dono ko add kar de: 70 + 160 = 230 km.

Best Approach: Fraction method sabse smooth hai.

Summary: Fractions yaad hone ka yahi sabse bada fayda hai ki steps gayab ho jate hain.

questions.q: In a school, number of students in class A is 35%, number of students in class B be 15% while in class C number of students is 30%. If total number of students in class D be 120, then find total number of students in the school.
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, total percentage 100% hota hai. A(35%) + B(15%) + C(30%) = 80%. Matlab D ka share 20% hai. Question mein 20% ki value 120 di hai. Total nikalne ke liye 5 se multiply kar do, 120 * 5 = 600.

Best Method: Direct unitiary method laga.

Summary: Percentages jab add hoke ek simple bacha fraction de toh directly equivalent rakh do.

questions.q: In the year 2014, the population of a city was 30,000. The population of the city increased in 2015, 2016 and 2017 by a constant number. In the year 2018, if the population of the city was increased by 20% over the previous year then the population of the city become 27600 more than that of the year 2014. What is the ratio of the percentage increase in the population of the city over the previous year in the year 2015 to that in the year 2017 over the previous year?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, dhyan se samajh. 2018 mein total 57600 hui (30000 + 27600). Ye 2017 ka 120% hai. Toh 2017 ki pop = 57600 / 1.2 = 48000. 2014 se 2017 tak (3 saal) barabar badhi hai. 30000 se 48000 hui, yani 18000 badhi. Har saal 6000 badhi. 2015 ka % increase = 6000 / 30000 = 1/5. 2017 ka % increase = 6000 / (2016 ki pop yani 42000) = 1/7. Ratio = (1/5) : (1/7) = 7:5.

Best Approach: Step-by-step reverse aana best hai, AP (Arithmetic Progression) ka dhyan rakh.

Summary: Constant number matlab AP, backward calculation is fast.

questions.q: The population of a town decreases by x% in the year 2020 and increases by 2x% in the year 2021. If the population of the city at the end of 2019 is 45000 and that of the city at the end of 2021 is 49536, then find the value of x.
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... Equation banegi 45000 * (1 - x/100) * (1 + 2x/100) = 49536. Par hum options se khelenge! Option 14% utha. Pehle 14% decrease (yani 86%), fir 28% increase (yani 128%). Digital Sum laga: 45000 ka DS 9 hai, L.H.S hamesha 9 ka multiple hoga! 49536 ka DS bhi 9 hai. Ab Unit digit dekho. 45000 * 0.86 * 1.28 me last digits 6 aur 8 hain -> 6*8=48. Exact value match ho jaati hai.

Best Method: Options se value put karke Unit Digit aur DS check karna.

Summary: Quadratics mat banana exam mein, options use karke verify kar lena chahiye.

questions.q: Out of total income a person's expenditure on food, cloth and other items are in the ratio of 3: 4: 3 respectively. If his expenditure is increased by 12% on food and 15% on cloth and decreased by 8% on other items. What percent should his income be increased so that no effect is recorded on the consumption of food, cloth and other items ?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, ratio ko 300, 400 aur 300 maan le. Total income ho gayi 1000. Food pe 12% badha yani +36, Cloth pe 15% badha yani +60, Other pe 8% kam hua yani -24. Net effect nikalo: 36 + 60 - 24 = 72. Total expenditure 72 se badh gaya. Same aukaat maintain rakhne ke liye income bhi 72 badhani padegi 1000 pe. 72/1000 * 100 = 7.2%.

Best Approach: 100 multiples mein assume karke direct deviation nikalna.

Summary: Jaha ratio ho, zeroes laga ke life aasan banao.

questions.q: If x% of a is the same as y% of b, then z% of b will be
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, sidha equate kar. xa = yb. Hamein b ki value a ke terms mein chahiye. b = xa / y. Question ne 'z% of b' pucha hai, toh b ki jagah xa/y rakh de. Ye ban jayega z * (xa/y) % = (zx/y)% of a.

Best Approach: Simple substitution.

Summary: Variables dekh ke ghabrana nahi, jo pucha hai bas usko replace kardo equation se.

questions.q: In a group of 50 people, 20 like reading, 30 like travelling and 15 like both reading and travelling. How many like either reading and travelling?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, ye set theory ka basic baccha question hai. Either A or B ka formula hota hai A + B - Both. Sidha value rakh: 20 + 30 - 15 = 35. Venn Diagram bhi bana sakta hai, Only Reading = 5, Only Travelling = 15, Both = 15. Total = 5 + 15 + 15 = 35.

Best Approach: Direct formula apply kar.

Summary: 'Either OR' hamesha union hota hai.

questions.q: In an examination a candidate must secure 40% marks to pass. A candidate, who gets 220 marks, fails by 20 marks. What are the maximum marks for the examination?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, 220 laye aur 20 marks se fail ho gaye. Matlab pass hone ke liye 240 chahiye the. Aur percentage mein pass mark 40% hai. Seedha matlab hua 40% = 240. Toh 10% = 60. Max marks (100%) honge 600.

Best Approach: Direct unitary method, no formula.

Summary: Fail/Pass wale question me hamesha passing marks balance kiya kar.

questions.q: A person invests 35% of his income in mutual funds, 25% in fixed deposits, and the rest in recurring deposits. After 2 years, the mutual funds grow by 20%, fixed deposits by 10% and recurring deposits by 15%. If his total income is Rs. 1,60,000, what is the total percentage return on his entire investment portfolio after 2 years?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, total amount 1,60,000 sirf gumrah karne ke liye diya hai CDS/CGL style mein! Apna percentages lo. MF 35, FD 25, toh RD bacha 40. MF pe 20% return yani 35 ka 20% = 7. FD pe 10% yani 25 ka 10% = 2.5. RD pe 15% yani 40 ka 15% = 6. Total return = 7 + 2.5 + 6 = 15.5. Total 100 pe 15.5 ka return direct 15.5% hota hai.

Best Approach: Weighted average / Deviation method.

Summary: Jab answer percentage me pucha ho toh actual value ki zarurat nahi hoti.

questions.q: A scholarship fund of Rs. 1200 is to be distributed between two students, A and B, in a ratio 5:3. However, after allocating 200 to administrative charges, the remaining amount is first increased by 10% as a bonus before the final division. What amount will student A receive? (PHASE XIII(HS) - 24/07/2025 - SHIFT 2)
questions.s:
Dekh bhai aise karna hai... 1200 mein se 200 gaye bache 1000. Isme 10% bonus joda, toh ho gaya 1100. Ab isko 5:3 mein baatna hai. Total 8 parts = 1100, toh 1 part = 137.5. A ka share hai 5 parts = 137.5 * 5 = 687.5.

Best Method: Ratio ko fraction banake direct multiply karo, A = 1100 * (5/8).

Summary: Chain calculation me steps step-by-step follow karo without writing too much.

questions.q: In the Garbar Jhala, Aminabad a shopkeeper first raises the price of a Jewellery by x% then he decreases the new price by x%. After one such up down cycle, the price of a Jewellery decreased by Rs. 21025. After a second updown cycle the jewellery was sold for Rs. 484416. What was the original price of the jewellery?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, ye question exam me time kharab kar sakta hai. Isko Option Se udana hai. Ek hi formula hai: x% up and x% down ka matlab hamesha x^2/100 % ka loss hota hai. Agar Hum Option 5,25,625 lete hain, toh iska kitna percent 21025 hai? 21025 / 525625 = 1/25 = 4%. Yani loss 4% ka hai per cycle. Check karte hain: 5,25,625 - 21025 = 5,04,600 bacha ek cycle baad. Ab ispe wapas 4% loss nikalo: 5,04,600 ka 4% = 20184. Isko 5,04,600 se minus karo = 484416. Match ho gaya!

Best Approach: Options Elimination + Reverse Engineering is deadly.

Summary: Complex variable wale successive me options use karke common fractions dhoondhna best trick hai.

questions.q: In a contest held all over the country, 185 contestants won prizes after participating in the final round. 60% of the contestants could not make it to the final round. If 63% of the people participating in the final round did not win any prizes, then how many people participated in the contest?
questions.s:
Dekh bhai TestRipper, peeche se solve karte hain. Final me 63% kuch nahi jeete, toh jeete kitne? 37%. Inhi 37% ki value 185 di hai. Toh Final participants = 185/37 * 100 = 500. Ab question bolta hai 60% log final me aane se reh gaye, iska matlab sirf 40% final tak pahuche. Toh Total ka 40% = 500. Total = 500 * 100 / 40 = 1250.

Best Method: Backwards chalna and tree method use karna.

Summary: Jaha chain toot rahi ho waha steps ko piche se follow karo.

questions.q: The total number of male and female population in a city increased by 25% from 1970 to 1980. During the same period, the male population increased by 40% while the female population increased by 20%. From 1980 to 1990, the female population increased by 25%. In 1990, if the female population is twice the male population, then the percentage increase in the total of male and female population in the city from 1970 to 1990 is.
questions.s:
Dekh bhai, Alligation zindabad! 1970-1980 me male 40% badhe, female 20% badhi aur over-all 25% badhe. Alligation lagaya: Male(40) aur Female(20) ka mix 25 hai. Ratio aayega 5:15 = 1:3. M ko 100 aur F ko 300 maan le, total 1970 me hue 400. 1980 me M = 140 aur F = 360 ho gaye. 1990 me F 25% badhke 450 ho gayi. Diya hai 1990 me Female Male ke double hain, toh M = 225 honge. Total 1990 me = 450+225 = 675. 400 se 675 hona matlab 275 badhna 400 pe. 275/400 * 100 = 68.75%.

Best Approach: Alligation is the ultimate time saver here!

Summary: Jaha bhi individual average diya ho aur combine average diya ho, alligation bina soche laga diya karo.
